verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents public REST APIs, including the headless checkout APIs, and publishes an API reference whose pages can be called live from the browser. Endpoint-level reference pages exist for onramp and offramp orders and payment methods, alongside API-key docs and an llms.txt (HTTP 200) for AI ingestion. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
